hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"; [ -n "$root" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in "$root"/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; cd "$root" || exit 1; status=0; case "$f" in */packages/*.ts|*/packages/*.tsx) "$root/node_modules/.bin/oxlint" --fix --deny-warnings --report-unused-disable-directives "$f" || status=$? ;; esac; "$root/node_modules/.bin/oxfmt" --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern "$f" > /dev/null || status=$?; exit $status
hooks.statusMessage: Linting and formatting the edited file...

hooks.command: root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"; cd "$root" && ./packages/strategydance-web/node_modules/.bin/tsc -b packages/strategydance-core packages/strategydance-database packages/strategydance-design-system packages/strategydance-translations packages/strategydance-emails packages/strategydance-backend packages/strategydance-web
